propositions: Four read-only, deterministic metric functions must be implemented in git_metrics.py to derive code-health metrics from git history and module line counts: module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, churn, and refactor_to_addition_ratio.
Module size metrics must scan src/rebar/**/*.py line counts against a single-sourced hard cap from .github/module-size-limit.txt (not multi-file per-module ceilings).
cap_change_events must return a list of dicts containing old_limit/new_limit from git log history of the cap file; zero events returns an empty list (not None or Unavailable).
All four metrics must be registered in REGISTRY with lens='code_health', source='git', confidence='high', wrapped as single-arg context-adapters that pull repo_root/since/until from the c085 context.

Unit tests must verify exact metric outputs: module_size_distribution fields (count/max_loc/over_cap_count), churn totals, refactor_to_addition_ratio (returning None when insertions=0), and cap_change_events list structure across fixture repos.
